% Reproduction fixture for BUG-21:
% find_pkg_lib regex [a-z0-9\+\-\.]+ does not match package names with
% underscores. \usepackage{defs_pp1} is silently dropped from the
% minimal preamble because "defs_pp1" contains an underscore character.
%
% Observed in 2502.01497 where defs_pp1.sty defines \cC, \BC, etc.
% Without \usepackage{defs_pp1} in the pipeline preamble, all macros
% defined in that local .sty file become undefined.
%
% To reproduce locally: create a my_defs.sty file alongside this main.tex
% that defines \myMacro, then run through the pipeline.
%
% my_defs.sty content:
%   \newcommand{\myMacro}{\mathcal{M}}
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
% The following line is dropped by find_pkg_lib (underscore in name):
\usepackage{my_defs}
\begin{document}
$\myMacro$ is a macro defined in my\_defs.sty.
\end{document}
